entries.reason: a section header of iOS 6 has no padding above it, so there is none to set

entries.reason: the system's key shortcuts of iOS 6 are handled before an application sees a key, so a key command has none to take priority over
entries.effect: the value is kept, starts as NO and is answered back, and says once in the log when it is set to YES that it is not applied
